compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Judgment names conflict, toil, and death beside The garden is planted and the human is placed; The human pair meet in the garden; The fruit is taken and hiding begins; The Jordan plain is seen like the LORD’s garden. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
